## Goal

The CLI agents use every day: every capability through one thin client, predictable JSON, exit codes and no prompts.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| AX-01 | Every CLI command has `--json`, documented exit codes and no prompts in non-interactive or JSON mode; logs go to stderr | M | Contract test per command: --json schema, exit codes, no prompts without a TTY, logs on stderr |
| AX-09 | The CLI implements the D60 command set plus `mostra run` and `mostra state`, with the exit codes of INTERFACES §9 | I | Every D60 command plus run and state implemented with contract tests (`term` arrives with WP-22 in v1.1, D122) |
| VR-06 | Versions referenced by submissions, views or review sets are never garbage-collected | I | gc property test never removes a version referenced by a submission, view, review set or follow; dry run lists candidates |
| VR-08 | `mostra dev` offers optional hot reload for developers, clearly separate from viewing | I | `mostra dev` hot-reloads on a separate port and is unreachable through capability URLs |
| EN-08 | Standalone CLI telemetry per D119: first-run notice, opt-out (setting, variable, `DO_NOT_TRACK`), the public event list, no content or identifiers, never in embedded use | M, I | Seeded: a host-spawned instance (`mostra host`) sends nothing; `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` sends nothing; payloads match the documented schema and contain no paths or tokens. WP-11 adds the SDK-spawned case to the same test |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- `@mostra/cli` as a thin protocol client covering D60 plus `run` and `state`, with daemon autostart;
- `--json` on every command, NDJSON streams, the exit codes, no prompts outside a TTY, logs on stderr;
- generated help;
- `mostra dev` (HMR, separate port, never a capability URL);
- `doctor`, `gc` with its reference rules, and `docs`;
- anonymous telemetry in the standalone CLI (D119): the first-run notice (drafted with Mirza, D74), opt-out by a setting, a variable or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, the public event list, and nothing sent from embedded use.

Sign-in and sharing commands for remote servers arrive in WP-29.

Design detail for this package:

- From WP-06 (D101): `mostra wait`, `results` and `state get|set|patch` are thin clients of `wait`, `results/get` and `state/*` (exit code 5 for `still_waiting`, 6 for `MOSTRA_SUBMIT_ALREADY` and conflicts); `mostra gc --compact-events --before <cursor>` calls the interaction core's `compactEvents` per artifact in one transaction, and its reads already answer `MOSTRA_HOST_CURSOR_COMPACTED`. IN-10's CLI check is closed here.
- Thin protocol client with daemon autostart and attach; NDJSON for streams.
- `mostra dev`: Vite HMR on a separate port, never reachable through capability URLs (VR-08).
- `doctor`, `gc` (reference rules, dry run), `docs`, `state`.
- Telemetry (D119, EN-08): the standalone CLI sends anonymous usage events by default, announced on first run and off through a setting, an environment variable or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`; a host-spawned instance, and any home a host configures, sends nothing. Events carry no artifact content, paths, tokens, identities or IP addresses; useful fields are the command, its outcome and duration, the Mostra version, the platform and the agent or harness that ran it (MCP `clientInfo` or known environment markers). The endpoint is configurable and disabled in development builds. The event list and detection rules are a *Deferred decision* for this package with Mirza, and the first-run notice is agent-facing prose (D74); the event list is published in the docs.
- Help text generated from command definitions; the wording is drafted with Mirza (D74).
- `mostra dev` implements `RenderMode.dev` (ROUND-3 §7) beside WP-03's `build`, on the same SPA build settings.
- `mostra add <package…> [--artifact <path|id>]` is the client of WP-04's `deps/add` (D95), defaulting to the artifact in the current directory; `MOSTRA_DEP_MISSING`'s fix already carries that exact command, so add a contract test that runs the command a diagnostic names. `mostra dev` resolves packages through the same `Dependencies.resolve`.
- `gc` also collects WP-04's dependency state (D95): lock layouts in `deps/locks` that no working lockfile (`dependency_lock`) and no kept version's `lock.yaml` names, then `pnpm store prune` through the install child (pnpm 10, D94), removing the pruned packages from `dependency_package`; never while an install runs.
- `mostra doctor` closes LL-05's doctor half (D96): it warns when the home has artifacts with submission policy `none` (read through `artifact/list`) and no always-on daemon, which is the login-service unit WP-08's `mostra daemon install` writes for the home; extend WP-05's LL-05 evidence row with that check.
- Add `mostra dev` to WP-05's VR-03 route enumeration (`packages/runtime/test/integration/routes.test.ts`, D96): no viewer URL reaches the dev server or the source it serves.
- `mostra open` and `mostra publish` print the capability URL; `mostra open --rotate` and `--revoke` are clients of `view/rotate` and `view/revoke` (D97).

## Out of scope

- `share` drivers (WP-13)
- `mcp` (WP-15)
- `plugin` (WP-16)
- `term` (WP-22, after the first release, D122)
- `export` classes beyond the receipt (WP-24)
- `mostra run <bundle>`, sign-in and sharing commands for remote servers (WP-29)

## Acceptance evidence

contract tests per command (JSON schema, exit code, behavior outside a TTY); `gc` never removes a referenced version (property test); `dev` is unreachable through viewer URLs; a host-spawned instance and `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` send no telemetry, and payloads match the documented schema with no paths or tokens (EN-08).

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Keep the CLI free of logic the protocol lacks: anything a host can't do through the protocol is a protocol gap to fix.

## Handoff

J1 runs end to end from a terminal.
